description: This PHP source file defines the SaveNationalityController class within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. The class extends AbstractVueController and manages the pre-render logic for handling nationality data, specifically determining whether to load an 'edit' or 'save' component based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveNationalityController
classes.description: Controller class for saving or editing nationality entries within the OrangeHRM system. It determines which Vue component to render ('nationality-edit' or 'nationality-save') based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component to be rendered by the controller. Checks if an 'id' attribute is present in the request to decide whether to load an existing nationality for editing or prepare for saving a new one.
